meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 它会按9个维度扫描代码库、查找技术债务,每条发现标注文件位置,最终在仓库根目录生成TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,含执行摘要、严重级别、工时估算和优先修复清单。
howto.when: 当用户要求做代码库健康检查、技术债务审计或架构审查等时,或说出“tech debt”、“technical debt”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个代码库的技术债务。
say.note: 触发9维度审计流程并生成报告。

say.text: 做一次代码库健康检查,列出优先修复项。
say.note: 输出含前五项优先级的审计文档。

say.text: 看看我们的架构和代码质量有什么问题。
say.note: 进行架构与质量扫描并给出建议。

howto.what_en: It audits the codebase across 9 dimensions to find technical debt, citing file locations for every finding. It then produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with an executive summary, severity levels, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Used when asked for a codebase health check, tech debt audit, or architecture review, or when user says trigger phrases like 'tech debt', 'technical debt', and similar.

say_en.text: Help me audit this codebase for technical debt.
say_en.note: Triggers the 9-dimension audit and generates the report.

say_en.text: Run a codebase health check and list priority fixes.
say_en.note: Outputs audit doc with top 5 priorities.

say_en.text: Inspect our architecture and code quality for issues.
say_en.note: Scans architecture and quality, then reports findings.
